# Edward Batt — Digital Transformation

> Edward Batt is an end-to-end digital transformation specialist. He combines 30+ years of international executive and operational experience with hands-on software architecture and engineering. He analyses how a business operates, maps its processes and systems, identifies inefficiencies and opportunities, and then designs and builds the technical solution himself: custom web applications, existing platforms configured and integrated, systems integration, workflow automation, AI, or a combination. The technology is chosen to fit the business problem, not the other way around. He works with organisations across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Europe, remotely or on site, in English, Bahasa Indonesia and Malay.

## Services: the full lifecycle, or any part of it

1. Discovery (free, 20 minutes): a conversation about the business, where it loses time and money, and what it is trying to achieve.
2. Mapping and analysis (fixed price, typically 1–2 weeks): a current-state map of core processes and systems, with inefficiencies, risks and opportunities identified and ranked.
3. Solution design (included with mapping): the solution and architecture that fits the problem, expected return and effort, a sequenced plan, human checkpoints for every automated or AI-assisted step.
4. Build and integrate (quoted per project): Edward builds custom software, integrations, automated workflows and AI components himself, with automated tests and deployment, or configures and connects existing platforms where they are the right answer.
5. Deploy and improve (optional retainer): production deployment, monitoring and measured improvement.

Engagements that can be taken on their own: custom software development; systems integration; technical review and architecture; AI implementation; platform selection and procurement; hands-on technical leadership (fractional CTO or transformation lead).

Technical capabilities: multi-tenant web applications and platforms in TypeScript with React or Svelte; PostgreSQL schema design, row-level security, migrations and database tests; APIs, webhooks, job queues and bots for integration and automation; large language models with deterministic rules and human approval outside the model; serverless and edge deployment, CI pipelines, automated end-to-end testing; English and Arabic interfaces.

Pricing: the discovery call is free; every engagement is scoped and priced before it starts.

## Results

- Regional creative agency (Iraq, Egypt, Dubai): mapped operations and designed and built an operations platform: intake from any channel into one record; AI-assisted briefs with AI-proposed deliverables from the agency's deliverables catalogue (a person approves); fully automated workflow where approved items are forwarded automatically to the people who need them; resource-first scheduling with capacity checked before commitment, SLAs and time tracking; document control with automatic versioning, filing and archiving; role-based access control and audit trail; finance export; exceptions dashboard; multi-tenant; English and Arabic. Working pilot about six weeks after mapping began.
- GGI esports platform (Iraq): as CTO, solution architect and lead developer. Smart tournament engines scaling from small events to 4,000+ competitors (formats, brackets, fixtures, advancement), two-way synchronisation with Discord, automatic generation of social media plans to promote tournaments, registration, teams, referees, results and rankings, in English and Arabic. MVP in about three months, full functionality in six; 5,000+ users registered in the first three months.
- Keystone: a command-line tool that keeps requirements, decisions, rules and lessons in the repository and deterministically compiles the context an AI coding agent needs for each task. Eight commands, three-role review gate, 248 automated tests, used to manage its own development.
- Accounts payable prototype: AI reads and matches invoices to purchase orders; approval limits are enforced by fixed rules outside the AI; anything over the limit waits for a named approver; every step is logged.
- Also: lead solution and business-model architect for SideGig, a creator–brand marketplace; technical review of a mobile game project for MBC Group; a support chatbot platform answering from a company's own documents; a tournament site for an esports event in the UAE built on Google Sheets and Apps Script.

## Background

30+ years in operations, contracts and procurement (oil, gas and LNG, logistics and cold chain, mining and infrastructure) across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, Australia and South America; Chief Operations Officer, Director of Operations, Senior Contracts and Procurement Manager; former Chief Technology Officer (ESTAZ, 2023–2026); RAAF School of Languages Indonesian linguist graduate.
